sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1-State.
Issue notice to respondent No.2, returnable in the first week of August, 2023.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.162/2022, Police Sation Osian, District Jodhpur for the offence under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471 & 120-B of IPC.
However, he shall join the investigation.
